I have been a patient of this practice for many years. I've always been polite and professional even when I've found the Receptionists to be unsupportive and treated as just another number when you call. On this specific occasion -with a history of long term  blood  disorder,  I rang to see if I could get an appointment to speak with the GP...a two week wait or 3 weeks for a face to face appointment. Wow!

Obviously, as I explained to the Receptionist , ideally, I need a blood test to check my levels .

I was told there were no appointments of any kind and to ring back the following Monday!...its a known fact that receptionists  can be  inherently rude at times  and off-putting to say the least . I understand they receive  hundreds of calls and I'm just another number, another caller, etc. However, do they not accept that it's frustrating and very scary to be faced with not knowing who to turn to in a case where you are genuinely worried and that you were hospitalised prior as an  emergency.

I'm not a hypochondria   but my health is paramount like many of us.

A change of attitude is all that's needed.   Certainly, receptionists should be trained in being more conducive towards patients who are polite and are not aggressive.
I also have noticed that RECEPTIONISTS aren't always descrerete when dealing with patients. Id rather not be asked "Are you still taking......" in full view and I  front of people in t he waiting Room. Either write it down or speak extremely quietly. I value my privacy but common sense tells you as a Receptionist in a Gp practice discretion and professionalism. Otherwise on the whole, a good practice .",null,[0,239]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPdUx1eWdRRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x8719a2a07a44ba66!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICOuLuygQE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPdUx1eWdRRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPdUx1eWdRRRIlChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPdUx1eVFREgswZGlLY0o2VGpOOBomChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPdUx1eXdRRRILMGRpS2NKNlRqTjgiEgkAAAAAAAAAABFmukR6oKIZhyoLMGRpS2NKNlRqTjg&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiU87Tky7OTAxULEWMBHQx8BlQQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,9]]]],"0ahUKEwiU87Tky7OTAxULEWMBHQx8BlQQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESYENBRVFBUnBDUTJrNFNVRlNTVzVEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDFFTFVOR2FWOWZSV2hCVnpWRVRtOTNPWE5XVkRJemEzVmFTVUZCUVVGQlIyZG1YMEZ0VFVRdFEwWnBSMEZCYVVGQg=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNCcExTalpnEAE",["0x0:0x8719a2a07a44ba66",null,1671287881678337,1771584680269385,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113278106619517405824/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Danii R","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW0NPywUq3DS491HngJKZwFskcLTLlA5i10schB0AL4CY_UUn0z=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113278106619517405824?hl=en"],"113278106619517405824",null,29,8,null,[1,5,1],1,["Local Guide · 29 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiU87Tky7OTAxULEWMBHQx8BlQQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"Edited a month ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I’ve recently moved to a new city and was genuinely gutted to have to leave this GP service.
